name: json
description: Native workspace json.validate.enable is boolean. json.schemas is an array of {fileMatch: string[], schema: inline JSON Schema} or url associations. This server assigns validateEnabled from settings.json.validate.enable on configuration updates; missing that field is not a harmless generic settings update. Inline schemas need no network. The dotted paths above describe nested JSON objects, NOT literal dotted property names. Exact settings shape: {"json":{"validate":{"enable":true},"schemas":[{"fileMatch":["*.json"],"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"port":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["port"]}}]}}. The built-in client passes this object unchanged; it does not expand dotted keys. The port schema in configurationExample illustrates a project-specific rule; it is not enabled by the preset. Choose schemas for your actual project.
